services.desc: The 50’ Carmel is an inexpensive boat perfectly suited for a small group of people. This houseboat features a living area in the front salon, a fully equipped kitchen, 2 bedrooms, and 1 full bath. The 50’ Tuolumne is an inexpensive boat perfectly suited for a small group of people. This boat is similar to the standard 50’ Tuolumne, but with additional interior space, a sun canopy, and a small patio space on the rear deck. Consider the pricing and list of amenities and see if the 50’ Tuolumne houseboat meets your vacation needs. The 56’ Gold Rush is a relatively new houseboat model. blurb: Guests can rent houseboats ranging from 50 to 70 feet, equipped for vacations but excluding food. The marina also offers powerboat rentals and boat slips. Lake Don Pedro features nearly 160 miles of shoreline with year-round fishing and water sports.

quotes.author: Travis Saracco
quotes.text: Had an excellent time on the lake with the boys. The staff at the Marina was super helpful on getting us first-timer-houseboaters situated. This is a perfect spot for a weekend outing.

quotes.author: Carolina Delorenzo
quotes.text: Had a great time today! The crew there was very accommodating. We will be back again. Thanks guys!

quotes.author: Jamie Glenn
quotes.text: Great service! Even drove out to our houseboat to see if everything was going well for us!
